name: ark4ne/laravel-api-revisions
description: Typed schemas and their evolution through ordered API revisions, Stripe-style, for Laravel.

suggest.phpstan/extension-installer: Registers extension.neon, which types the custom types of Schema (README).
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required by the Testing assertions (assertRevisionsAreConsistent, assertMatchesRevisionSchema).
suggest.opis/json-schema: Required by the schema assertions of the Testing helpers (assertMatchesRevisionSchema, assertRendersAtEveryRevision).

scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the tests with line coverage and fail under 90%.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at max level with Larastan, the phpat architecture rules and the disallowed calls.
scripts-descriptions.stan:baseline: Regenerate the PHPStan baseline (it may only shrink: review the diff).
scripts-descriptions.mutation: Run mutation testing (requires infection to be installed globally).
scripts-descriptions.fixtures:update: Write the expected files of the Feature tests (tests/Feature/**/expected/*.json): review the diff.
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Compare the projection time and peak memory at the head and at the oldest revision (fails on regression).
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every blocking check of the CI locally.
